title: Speculative enquiry: graduate site or civil engineer (Bella Vista NSW)
content_text: Delaney Civil careers page (read 11 Oct 2026 AEDT): 'We regularly recruit for roles including: Plant Operators, Civil Labourers, Leading Hands and Supervisors, Site Engineers, Project Managers, Graduates.' 'Expressions of interest: Don't see a role that fits right now? We're always keen to hear from experienced civil construction professionals and those looking to build a career in the industry. Send your CV and a brief introduction to info@delaneycivil.com.au'. No specific vacancy listed. Home page expertise: bridge design, construction and maintenance; bulk earthworks and land remediation; concrete and retaining structures; flood remediation and landslips; road construction; stormwater drainage and utility services. About page: leadership Gerard Delaney (Founding Director), Aram Vesmadian (Managing Director), Alycia Delaney (Management Cadet, oversees HR, HSEQ and site operations). Contact: Unit 311/33 Lexington Drive, Bella Vista NSW 2153, 02 9836 4440, info@delaneycivil.com.au.
apply_instructions: No advertised vacancy. The careers page invites a CV and brief introduction to info@delaneycivil.com.au.
